meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后,每当“改代码”这个动作成功完成,如果注释检查器报告了警告,助手必须先修复或解释被标记的注释,之后才能继续做别的。
howto.when: 在 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类工具执行成功后,若注释检查器发出警告才触发;非编辑操作或缺少检查器程序时不会阻断。

say.text: 修复刚才被注释检查器标出来的注释。
say.note: 助手会先处理这条注释再继续任务。

say.text: 解释下这条警告里注释的问题在哪里。
say.note: 助手会先讲明原因,再继续下一步。

howto.what_en: After installation, whenever an edit action succeeds and comment-checker emits a warning, the assistant is blocked until it fixes or explains the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Only triggered after successful edit tools such as apply_patch, write, or edit when the comment checker reports warning; non-edit operations are ignored, and missing checker binaries do not block work.

say_en.text: Fix the comment the checker just flagged.
say_en.note: The assistant will address it before continuing.

say_en.text: Explain what is wrong with this flagged comment.
say_en.note: The assistant will explain before moving on.
